svg.title: Figure 3-6. SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 1 of 7 (SWF)
svg.desc: SW FMEA failure chains, sheet 1 of 7 (SWF rev 0.8): failure modes SWF-005 to SWF-001 (10 failure modes, 13 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-6 · SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 1 of 7
SWF rev 0.8 · BL-005 · draft · SWF-005 … SWF-001 · 13 causes on this sheet

(safety.h:683-701); the back-to-back test found that the reset…

Steering request above the torque or torque-rate limit for
Panda torque limits (max 1500, rate up 15 / down 25, error 350) are

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
